tips.text: Rank Atomos and Dual Zoren to 30 before feeding them in; building Twin Basolk destroys them.
Build a fresh vanilla Atomos instead of feeding in your Forma'd or Incarnon one; pick the right copy in the foundry.
Farm the two Argon Crystals the same day you start Atomos; they halve at 00:00 GMT.
Grab Argon from any Void mission or fissure run you are already doing; it usually covers two.
Keep a separate Atomos if you want the Incarnon Genesis later; the consumed one loses it.
Nobody complains about the farm; it is credits and foundry timers.
